title: Whatever intoxicates in large amounts, its small amount is forbidden
hadeeth: Jābir ibn ‘Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with him and his father) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said: "Whatever intoxicates in large amounts, its small amount is forbidden."
attribution: Narrated by Abu Dāwūd, At-Tirmidhi, Ibn Mājah, and Ahmad
explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) clarified that any drink or food that causes the loss of control over mental faculties when consumed in large quantities, then consuming a small amount of it is forbidden, even if it does not cloud the mind.
hints: Validity of blocking the means to evil by blocking all ways that lead to such evils.
The prohibition of a small amount of intoxicants, because it is a means to intoxication.
If it does not intoxicate, neither in small nor large amounts, then it is not forbidden.
hadeeth_intro: Jābir ibn ‘Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with him and his father) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said:
hadeeth_ar: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضيَ اللهُ عنهُما قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَا أَسْكَرَ كَثِيرُهُ فَقَلِيلُهُ حَرَامٌ».
hadeeth_intro_ar: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضيَ اللهُ عنهُما قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ:
explanation_ar: بيَّن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أن أي مشروب أو مأكول يُذهِب العقل عند تناول الكثير منه، فتناول القليل منه مُحرَّم حتى لو لم يُذهب العقل.
hints_ar: صحة اعتبار سَدّ الذرائع، وذلك بغَلْق كل ما يؤدّي إلى تلك الخبائث.
تحريم القليل من المسكر؛ لأنه وسيلة للسُّكْر.
إذا لم يُسكر لا القليل ولا الكثير، فإنه ليس بحرام.
attribution_ar: رواه أبو داود والترمذي وابن ماجه وأحمد
